name: employer_id
description: The employer (dim_employer), or NULL when the source row names none.

name: date
description: When it happened. NULL when the source row has no date.

name: date_precision
description: day, or month for sign-ups (dated the first of the month). NULL when date is NULL.

name: event_type
description: account_signup, survey_completed, was_request, was_session_held, was_completed or peer_mentoring_interest.

name: source
description: The source: signups, survey, was or peer.

name: source_ref
description: The source row's own id: signup_id, Entry Id, was_request_id, session_id or peer_id.
